name: IoT Real-Time Intelligence Dashboard
description: Real-time monitoring dashboard for IoT telemetry and analytics

variables.name: selectedLocation
variables.query: IoTTelemetry | distinct Location | order by Location asc

variables.name: selectedDeviceType
variables.query: IoTTelemetry | distinct DeviceType | order by DeviceType asc

tiles.title: Avg Temperature
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago({timeRange}) | summarize round(avg(Temperature), 2)

tiles.title: Temperature Trend by Location
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago({timeRange}) | where Location in ({selectedLocation}) or '{selectedLocation}' == 'All' | summarize AvgTemperature = avg(Temperature) by bin(EventTime, 5m), Location | render timechart

tiles.title: Humidity Trend by Location
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago({timeRange}) | where Location in ({selectedLocation}) or '{selectedLocation}' == 'All' | summarize AvgHumidity = avg(Humidity) by bin(EventTime, 5m), Location | render timechart

tiles.title: Device Status Distribution
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago(5m) | summarize arg_max(EventTime, *) by DeviceId | summarize Count = count() by Status | render piechart

tiles.title: Devices by Location
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago({timeRange}) | summarize DeviceCount = dcount(DeviceId) by Location | render columnchart

tiles.title: Top 10 Energy Consumers
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago({timeRange}) | summarize TotalEnergy = sum(EnergyConsumed) by DeviceId | top 10 by TotalEnergy desc | render barchart

tiles.title: Recent Alerts
tiles.query: DeviceAlerts | where AlertTime > ago({timeRange}) | order by AlertTime desc | project AlertTime, DeviceId, AlertType, Severity, Message | take 50

tiles.title: Device Geographic Distribution
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago(5m) | summarize arg_max(EventTime, *) by DeviceId | where isnotnull(Latitude) and isnotnull(Longitude) | project DeviceId, Location, Latitude, Longitude, Temperature, Status

tiles.title: Power Consumption Over Time
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago({timeRange}) | summarize TotalPower = sum(Power) by bin(EventTime, 5m) | render areachart

tiles.title: Temperature Anomaly Detection
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago(7d) | make-series AvgTemp = avg(Temperature) on EventTime step 1h | extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(AvgTemp, 1.5, -1, 'linefit') | project EventTime, AvgTemp, anomalies, baseline

tiles.title: Device Health Summary by Location
tiles.query: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago(1h) | summarize DeviceCount = dcount(DeviceId), AvgTemperature = round(avg(Temperature), 2), AvgHumidity = round(avg(Humidity), 2), TotalEnergy = round(sum(EnergyConsumed), 2), HealthyDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, Status == 'healthy'), UnhealthyDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, Status != 'healthy') by Location | extend HealthPercentage = round(HealthyDevices * 100.0 / DeviceCount, 2) | order by UnhealthyDevices desc

alerts.name: High Temperature Alert
alerts.condition: IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago(5m) | where Temperature > 90 | count | where Count > 5

alerts.name: Device Offline Alert
alerts.condition: let ActiveDevices = IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago(1h) | distinct DeviceId; let RecentDevices = IoTTelemetry | where EventTime > ago(10m) | distinct DeviceId; ActiveDevices | join kind=leftanti RecentDevices on DeviceId | count | where Count > 0
